format.runError.cronMisfire: This scheduled work started too late and was cancelled. Check the schedule, then start it manually if it still needs to run.
format.runError.deadline: The chat deadline passed before the work finished. Review the partial work, then set a new deadline before trying again.
format.runError.gatewayRestarted: The server restarted before the work could continue. Review the partial work, then start it again.
format.runError.modelUnavailable: The selected model is unavailable or access was refused. This reply could not be completed.
format.runError.noReply: No reply was sent. Check the partial work below, then send a new message if the Bot should try again.
format.runError.operatorPause: This chat was paused, so its queued work was cancelled. Resume the chat, then send a new message when you are ready.
format.runError.turnBudget: The chat reached its message limit, so this work was paused. Send a message to continue now, or wait for the limit to reset.
